Bhopal's Nishatpura Railway Station Reopens After 3 Years

Nishatpura Railway Station in Bhopal is set to reopen on July 28, three years after it was closed. Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will inaugurate the station, which is expected to ease travel for approximately 300,000 people. The reopening includes flagging off the first train from the station.
